user.title: Create a combined outlet
user.description: Select at least two physical outlets. Measurements are detected automatically from their devices. No helpers or YAML required.

data_description.switches: Select two or more individual outlets. Groups are not allowed.

measurements.title: Choose measurements
measurements.description: Untick any measurement the combined outlet should not show. The original outlets' sensors for the chosen measurements are hidden; the combined outlet shows them instead.

error.at_least_two: Choose at least two different outlets.
error.physical_switches_only: Choose physical outlets with their own device, not groups or virtual switches.
error.no_common_measurements: No measurements are available on all selected outlets. Check that the sensors are enabled and assigned to the original devices.
error.already_configured: This combination of outlets is already set up.

abort.already_configured: This combination of outlets is already set up.

init.title: Measurements
init.description: Untick any measurement the combined outlet should not show. Changes reload the integration.
